What steps will reproduce the problem? (please attach a simple model and

1. See stan-reference-1.0.3.pdf, p. 49, section 10.6 "Ordered Logistic and
Probit Regression"


What is the expected output? What do you see instead?

The current ordered probit spec is (I have added comments next to bugs, see
below for further notes):
data {
int<lower=2> K;
int<lower=0> N;
int<lower=1> D;
int<lower=1,upper=K> y[N]; # (1) Should be int<lower=0,upper=K-1>
y[N];
row_vector[D] x[N];
}
parameters {
vector[D] beta;
ordered[K-1] c;
}
model {
vector[K] theta;
for (n in 1:N) {
real eta;
eta <- x[n] * beta;
theta[1] <- 1 - Phi(eta - c[1]);
for (k in 2:(K-1))
theta[k] <- Phi(eta - c[k-1]) - erf(eta - c[k]); # (2)
erf(eta - c[k]) should be Phi(eta - c[k])
theta[K] <- Phi(eta - c[K-1]);
y[n] ~ categorical(theta);
} }

Please provide any additional information below.
